passives.name: Starving Devil
passives.description: (Passive Effect) When the caster has a Barrier, reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken by [Buff_V_4076007_15_3]. Increases damage dealt to non-Fire enemies and reduces damage taken from them. Reduces damage dealt to Fire enemies and increases damage taken from them.
